title: Concatenation of Consecutive Binary Numbers
goal: Concatenate binary representations from one through n and return the result modulo 1000000007.
strategy: Appending a binary word shifts the existing number by that word length and adds its value. Modular reduction preserves the requested remainder while keeping arithmetic bounded.
